sources.title: Fail-Fast, Restart-Smart: Early Failure Prediction and Restart for SWE Agentic Tasks
sources.task_scope: single active SWE-agent trajectory; inference-time control, not persistent self-improvement
sources.dataset: SWE-bench Verified, 500 instances split 350 train / 50 validation / 100 test; 11 trajectory seeds for data collection

controller.stop: 0.6B observable-prefix monitor; operating point calibrated by target false-positive-rate budget
controller.restart: fresh same-policy rollout with no previous prompt history
controller.state_transfer: interrupted repository diff offered as optional, initially-disabled overlay; agent may inspect/apply/discard

results.10pct_fpr_restart: +3.0 to +4.0 resolution points across three open policies with 20.5%-36.9% net token overhead

sources.design_inference: A stop controller should carry an explicit false-positive/collateral-damage budget; restart should separate physical progress from potentially misleading reasoning state. State transfer can be optional rather than forced.
not_support: proof that the same state-transfer rule is optimal outside SWE trajectories

sources.title: Self-Improvement Can Self-Regress: The Rise-and-Collapse Failure Mode of LLM Self-Training
sources.task_scope: weight-updating code post-training across 10 sequential 20-step campaigns; not harness evolution

control_levels.CARE: between-campaign memory with capability posterior, transfer gate and regression-aware belief revision
control_levels.ES: within-campaign early stopping; rolls forward peak checkpoint and sets next budget to peak_step+3
control_levels.GRPO: changes the RL update rule via group-relative reward normalization

results.qwen25_3b: CARE v2 end-of-chain pass@1 4.9% -> 9.5%, paired bootstrap 95% CI [+0.4,+8.9], gains in 4/5 seeds
results.grpo_plus_es: mixed: 2/3 seeds improve, one final cliff lowers mean to 17.0% [0.0,28.1]

sources.design_inference: Control-loop placement is regime-dependent: within-run stopping, between-run carryover gating and update-rule changes solve different failure modes and should be evaluated separately rather than collapsed into one self-improvement mechanism.
not_support: a universal superiority ordering among CARE/ES/GRPO
untouched outer-test evidence for persistent self-modifying artifacts

frontier_update: Add an explicit Stop/Restart axis to the repair-state controller. A useful matched future experiment should distinguish: continue current trajectory/policy, stop and discard, stop and restart clean, stop and restart with physical-artifact overlay, widen parallel branches, and reopen strategy. Calibrate false-positive harm separately from quality gain and evaluate on selection-unused outer data.
exact_next_action: Search real self-improving agent systems for a matched control experiment that combines persistent repair state with calibrated stop/restart and strategy branching/reopening under equal budgets and untouched outer evaluation. Keep FailFast and Self-Regress as scoped controller evidence, not as direct proof of persistent harness self-improvement.
